description: Full-text search of US mortgage regulator text (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, USDA, Ginnie Mae, SBA, CFPB). Inputs: `query`; optional `family` (one agency), `limit` (1-25), `currency_kind` (only sections carrying that currency signal; "any" = any signal). Common abbreviations (DTI, LTV, IRRRL, W-2, VOE, PITI, BK...) are expanded to the regulator's terms. Each result is one section: title, `obligation_id`, `canonical_citation` (the citation in the regulator's style, or null) and `excerpt`, a verbatim fragment near the match, not the whole rule. `match` is "all_terms" or "partial"; a partial result lists the query words it lacks in `missing_terms`. Order: `rank_score`, highest first = text score (title-weighted) x term coverage x title fit, with superseded, pending, incorporated or expired text x0.2, a special program's section (`special_program`: Home Possible, HomeReady, 203(k), HECM...) x0.5 unless the query names the program, and `obligation_type` "note" (source-credit notes) or "index" (a chapter heading) x0.2 unless the query asks for them. `section_status` "deleted" marks a deleted-section stub, ranked last. A query that is a citation returns the cited section first and sets `cited`; a bare handbook name ("HUD 4000.1") adds `handbook`, an outline of its parts. `currency` is null or a version/status signal whose kinds include dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, superseded-in-part (a Mortgagee Letter replaced some provisions, named in `headline`), modified-by (a later issuance changes it, optional until its mandatory date) and expired. `version` "in-force" or "update-18-optional" marks the two texts of an FHA section HUD's Update 18 revises (`mandatory_date` for the revision); `other_version` is the other text's obligation_id. Empty results carry `reason` (empty_query, no_match, no_match_above_threshold) and may carry `guidance` naming shorthand in the query.

currency_kind.description: Restricts results to sections carrying this currency signal; "any" = any signal.

name: search_regs

cited.description: When the query is a citation: {citation, register_ids}.

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

handbook.description: When the query names a whole handbook: its outline.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

reason.description: With empty results: empty_query, no_match or no_match_above_threshold.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

results.description: Ranked sections, highest rank_score first (may be empty).

also_at.description: Same-text copies dropped from the list.

canonical_citation.description: The citation in the regulator's style (e.g. "4000.1 II.A.5.d", "B3-3.3-07"), or null.

currency.description: null, or a version/status signal {kind, headline, detail, effective_date, mandatory_date, expires_on, as_of, links}; kind e.g. dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, superseded-in-part, modified-by, expired.

excerpt.description: A verbatim fragment near the match; not the whole rule.

mandatory_date.description: On an Update 18 revision: when it becomes mandatory.

missing_terms.description: On partial: the query terms this section lacks.

obligation_type.description: note or index: not rule text.

other_version.description: On a dual-version section: the other version's obligation_id.

page_url.description: The section's page on claudeforcompliance.com (verbatim text, currency notices, link to the regulator).

rank_score.description: The score results are ordered by.

source_url.description: The regulator's URL for the document.

special_program.description: The special program this section belongs to (ranked x0.5).

version.description: On a dual-version FHA section: "in-force" or "update-18-optional".

title: Search regulations
